explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows tirzepatide has been listed since 2022-12-15; no public FDA signal at our plants

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows tirzepatide has been listed since 2022-12-15 and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on the list for 46 months.
The product label identifies Eli Lilly and Company as the manufacturer.
There is no public FDA signal at our plants for this drug.
Corvale East holds 43 syringes of tirzepatide 2.5 mg/0.5 mL with a daily use of 4.2, providing 10.3 days on hand.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
